headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 31, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Anthony Kay earning the win. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. In other action, the Washington Nationals defeated the San Diego Padres 9-4, with Brad Lord earning the win after 2.0 innings of scoreless relief. Manny Machado led the Padres with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Craig Kimbrel, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays due to a right wrist strain. Harrison Bader has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the San Francisco Giants with left plantar fasciitis. Welinton Herrera has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies due to left elbow inflammation.

The Detroit Tigers have bolstered their pitching staff with the acquisition of left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays. The Washington Nationals have also made a move, acquiring left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist from the Colorado Rockies for cash.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to White Sox in Dominant 7-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Anthony Kay earning the win. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Nationals in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Brad Lord earning the win after 2.0 innings of scoreless relief. Manny Machado led the Padres with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Texas**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 7-6 decision to the Texas Rangers, coming up just one run short. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 6-5 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Albert Suárez earning the win. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. led the Blue Jays with 4 hits, while Brandon Young pitched 6.2 strong innings for the Jays.

top_news.title: **Rays' Closer Sidelined with Injury**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-handed pitcher Craig Kimbrel has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right wrist strain, effective retroactive to May 28, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade. Vasquez joins the Tigers after being dealt from the Toronto Blue Jays.
